target.name: Agentation v3.x + Live Schema Site (https://www.agentation.com/schema)
target.reconstruction_policy: Clean-room MIT reimplementation from behavioral contracts and AFS v1.1 specification

claims.summary: Annotation Format Schema (AFS) v1.1 defines three annotation kinds ('feedback', 'placement', 'rearrange') with discriminated required fields and shared element/position/workflow metadata.

The live site https://www.agentation.com/schema mounts an interactive PageToolbarCSS floating pill in the bottom-right corner with collapsed badge state and expanded controls (Annotate, Layout Place/Rearrange, Freeze Animations, Markers visibility, Output Detail cycling, Copy, Clear, Settings, and Session sync).

Element identification extracts human-readable label ('element'), compact selector path ('elementPath'), full DOM hierarchy ('fullPath'), CSS classes with module-hash stripping ('cssClasses'), test/QA data attributes ('attributes'), accessibility semantics ('accessibility'), nearby text/sibling context ('nearbyText', 'nearbyElements'), and tag-relevant vs. full forensic computed styles.

React Fiber tree walking extracts component hierarchy with four filtering modes ('off', 'filtered', 'smart', 'all') and resolves source file locations via _debugSource/__source in React <=18 and a temporary React 19 hook-dispatcher stack-trace probe fallback.

Deep hit-testing pierces open Shadow DOM roots and same-origin iframes (translating client coordinates across frame rects), while Alt/Option modifier collects elementsStack via elementsFromPoint to cycle through overlapping layers.

Design/Layout Mode supports two sub-modes: Place (wireframe component palette for button, input, text, card, image,section, nav, modal, badge, divider, avatar, toggle with alignment snap guides, 8-direction resize, and Blank Canvas toggle) and Rearrange (heuristic section detection, click-to-capture, drag-to-move/resize, original-rect ghost outlines, and getSpatialContext reference-frame extraction).

Output generation formats feedback, placement, and rearrange annotations into four Markdown detail tiers ('compact', 'standard', 'detailed', 'forensic') plus single-element copy formats ('source', 'classes', 'attribute', 'css', 'tailwind') and AFS v1.1 JSON.

Local session sync uses HTTP REST and SSE against a configurable endpoint (default http://localhost:4747) with /health, /sessions, /sessions/:id/annotations, and /pending routes plus status/thread lifecycle transitions ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'resolved', 'dismissed').

Self-driving critique systematically inspects page sections (Hero, Navigation, Visuals/Interactive Demos, Content Hierarchy, Copy/Taglines, CTAs/Footer), scrolls each target into view, attaches numbered AFS annotations with concrete 2-3 sentence critiques (naming the design principle and specific CSS/token replacements), and summarizes findings.
